640	// validateReport checks every archive legality condition against r. It is the
641	// single definition of a legal report: the id and artifact hash are 64
642	// lowercase hex characters, the id matches the content, the artifact name is
643	// present, rule ids are present and unique with non-empty versions, statuses
644	// use the five recorded values, tool-missing and timeout notes are
645	// non-blank, a 发现缺陷 rule never carries a note that is present yet entirely
646	// whitespace (an omitted or empty note stays legal for the invariant-boolean
647	// evidence form), and 发现缺陷 rules correspond one-to-one with findings whose
648	// artifact hash, version, severity, invariant and evidence match the rule.
649	// The same conditions apply to submissions and to stored archives: a
650	// recomputed id never makes an invalid report legal. fail is errInvalid for
651	// submissions and errCorrupt for stored archives.
652	func validateReport(r Report, fail func(string) error) error {
653		if !validReportID(r.ReportID) {
654			return fail("report id " + r.ReportID + " is not a 64-character lowercase hex string")
655		}
656		if r.Artifact.Name == "" {
657			return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " artifact name is required")
658		}
659		if !validReportID(r.Artifact.Hash) {
660			return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " artifact hash is not a 64-character lowercase hex string")
661		}
662		if ReportID(r) != r.ReportID {
663			return fail("report content does not match id " + r.ReportID)
664		}
665		seenRule := make(map[string]bool, len(r.Rules))
666		defectByID := make(map[string]ReportRule)
667		for _, rule := range r.Rules {
668			if rule.ID == "" {
669				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a rule with an empty id")
670			}
671			if seenRule[rule.ID] {
672				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has duplicate rule id " + rule.ID)
673			}
674			seenRule[rule.ID] = true
675			if rule.Version == "" {
676				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " has an empty version")
677			}
678			switch rule.Status {
679			case StatusUnchecked, StatusPass, StatusDefect, StatusToolMissing, StatusTimeout:
680			default:
681				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " has unknown status " + rule.Status)
682			}
683			if (rule.Status == StatusToolMissing || rule.Status == StatusTimeout) && strings.TrimSpace(rule.Note) == "" {
684				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " status " + rule.Status + " has no note")
685			}
686			if rule.Status == StatusDefect {
687				// A defect rule may carry no note at all (reports built only from
688				// invariant booleans, whose finding holds the generated evidence),
689				// but a note that is present yet entirely whitespace is not a
690				// checker description: the blankness judgement is the same
691				// TrimSpace one the audit submission applies. The evidence matching
692				// the note verbatim and the recomputed id matching the content can
693				// never make such a note legal, and the whole report is rejected
694				// rather than skipping the bad rule.
695				if rule.Note != "" && strings.TrimSpace(rule.Note) == "" {
696					return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " rule " + rule.ID + " status " + rule.Status + " has a blank note")
697				}
698				defectByID[rule.ID] = rule
699			}
700		}
701		seenFinding := make(map[string]bool, len(r.Findings))
702		for _, f := range r.Findings {
703			if f.RuleID == "" {
704				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a finding with an empty rule id")
705			}
706			rule, ok := defectByID[f.RuleID]
707			if !ok {
708				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " does not match a 发现缺陷 rule")
709			}
710			if seenFinding[f.RuleID] {
711				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " has a duplicate finding for rule " + f.RuleID)
712			}
713			seenFinding[f.RuleID] = true
714			if f.ArtifactHash != r.Artifact.Hash {
715				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has artifact hash " + f.ArtifactHash + ", want " + r.Artifact.Hash)
716			}
717			if f.Version != rule.Version {
718				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has version " + f.Version + ", want " + rule.Version)
719			}
720			if f.Severity != rule.Severity {
721				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has severity " + f.Severity + ", want " + rule.Severity)
722			}
723			if f.Invariant != rule.Invariant {
724				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has invariant " + f.Invariant + ", want " + rule.Invariant)
725			}
726			wantEvidence := rule.Note
727			if wantEvidence == "" {
728				wantEvidence = invariantEvidence(rule.Invariant)
729			}
730			if f.Evidence != wantEvidence {
731				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " finding for rule " + f.RuleID + " has evidence " + f.Evidence + ", want " + wantEvidence)
732			}
733		}
734		for id := range defectByID {
735			if !seenFinding[id] {
736				return fail("report " + r.ReportID + " defect rule " + id + " has no finding")
737			}
738		}
739		return nil
740	}

752	// firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString returns the first byte that is not valid UTF-8
753	// inside s. A Go string can carry any bytes, including bytes no JSON text may
754	// contain: json.Marshal (and therefore the canonical marshalling inside
755	// ReportID) silently replaces such a byte with U+FFFD instead of failing, so
756	// neither the id/content check nor the archive round trip can see it.
757	func firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString(s string) (byte, bool) {
758		for i := 0; i < len(s); {
759			r, size := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(s[i:])
760			if r == utf8.RuneError && size == 1 {
761				return s[i], true
762			}
763			i += size
764		}
765		return 0, false
766	}

768	// validateSubmittedText is the in-memory counterpart of the JSON character
769	// gates in ParseAuditInput and loadStoredReport. SaveReport accepts a Report
770	// built directly by a Go caller, whose strings never passed through JSON
771	// decoding; encoding/json marshals such a value without an error while
772	// replacing every invalid UTF-8 byte with U+FFFD, and ReportID computes from
773	// the same rewritten canonical form, so the recomputed id and the
774	// rule/finding correspondence would all match an archive whose text no
775	// longer equals what the caller handed over. Every caller-supplied string is
776	// therefore checked on the raw object — reportId, artifact name and hash,
777	// each rule definition field and status note, and each finding binding field
778	// and evidence — independently of which rules produced defects and of
779	// whether the report carries any finding at all. The rejection is an input
780	// error naming the exact field, with the array position of rules and
781	// findings, and it runs before any filesystem operation.
782	func validateSubmittedText(r Report) error {
783		check := func(field, value string) error {
784			if b, bad := firstInvalidUTF8ByteInString(value); bad {
785				return errInvalid(fmt.Sprintf("invalid UTF-8 byte 0x%02x in report field %s", b, field))
786			}
787			return nil
788		}
789		if err := check("reportId", r.ReportID); err != nil {
790			return err
791		}
792		if err := check("artifact.name", r.Artifact.Name); err != nil {
793			return err
794		}
795		if err := check("artifact.hash", r.Artifact.Hash); err != nil {
796			return err
797		}
798		ruleFields := []string{"id", "kind", "severity", "invariant", "version", "status", "note"}
799		for i, rule := range r.Rules {
800			values := []string{rule.ID, rule.Kind, rule.Severity, rule.Invariant, rule.Version, rule.Status, rule.Note}
801			for j, value := range values {
802				if err := check(fmt.Sprintf("rules[%d].%s", i, ruleFields[j]), value); err != nil {
803					return err
804				}
805			}
806		}
807		findingFields := []string{"artifactHash", "ruleId", "version", "severity", "invariant", "evidence"}
808		for i, finding := range r.Findings {
809			values := []string{finding.ArtifactHash, finding.RuleID, finding.Version, finding.Severity, finding.Invariant, finding.Evidence}
810			for j, value := range values {
811				if err := check(fmt.Sprintf("findings[%d].%s", i, findingFields[j]), value); err != nil {
812					return err
813				}
814			}
815		}
816		return nil
817	}

838	// reportShape is the fixed-field shape of a stored report archive: the agreed
839	// spellings at the top level and inside the artifact, every rule and every
